name: Alternative Antibiotics
summary: Investigate antimicrobial peptides by engineering and screening peptide libraries for activity against model organisms.

name: Aptamer
summary: Develop short nucleic-acid molecules that bind selected targets, with potential uses in diagnostics, treatments, and molecular sensors.

name: Autonomous Robots
summary: Study how service robots navigate around people and interpret the meaning of places in homes and offices.

name: Behavioral Neuroscience
summary: Use fruit flies to investigate how genes and neural circuits shape learning, memory, and behavior.

name: Big Data in Biology
summary: Use programming, statistics, and visualization to find biological patterns in large DNA and RNA sequencing datasets.

name: Biobricks
summary: Investigate protein function using molecular cloning, protein expression, and biochemical experiments.

name: Biodiversity Discovery
summary: Explore biodiversity and evolution, especially in amphibians and reptiles, through fieldwork, specimens, and laboratory analysis.

name: Biomanufacturing
summary: Investigate how engineered bacteria can produce and release useful small proteins more efficiently.

name: BioPowerhouses
summary: Study mitochondria through laboratory measurements of cellular function and computational comparisons of their genomes.

name: Bioprospecting
summary: Explore useful natural products, plant responses to stress, and microbes that interact with or break down plastics.

name: Bugs in Bugs
summary: Investigate which bacteria live with insects, how they interact, and whether they help or harm their hosts.

name: Computational Materials
summary: Use simulations and artificial intelligence to investigate battery materials, fuel-cell catalysts, and material properties.

name: Discovering Signals
summary: Investigate how extracellular ATP signals influence plant growth, using Arabidopsis root hairs and genetic experiments.

name: DIY Diagnostics
summary: Combine biology, chemistry, electronics, and programming to prototype accessible diagnostic tools.

name: EvoDevOmics
summary: Use genomic and gene-expression data to study how evolutionary changes produce differences in organisms’ traits.

name: Fish Behavior
summary: Test how social environments influence fish behavior, including learning, exploration, aggression, and mate choice.

name: Gene Networks
summary: Study protein–RNA complexes that help regulate gene expression, including proteins that reshape these complexes.

name: Glow Worms
summary: Use the nematode C. elegans to investigate how cells organize themselves during embryonic development.

name: iGEM
summary: Develop a collaborative synthetic-biology project, building laboratory and communication skills around the iGEM competition timeline.

name: Magnetic Matter
summary: Synthesize and characterize materials, including superconductors, to investigate their physical and magnetic properties.

name: Materials in Color
summary: Study how the chemical structures of dyes affect their interaction with light and their ability to initiate useful reactions.

name: Microbe Hackers
summary: Design and test genetic changes in bacteria to investigate new functions and the stability of engineered biological systems.

name: Plant Pathways
summary: Investigate the genetics controlling plant surface traits such as pigments, leaf hairs, and seed development.

name: Peptide Therapeutics - ARI
summary: Design and test peptides that interact with misfolded proteins, exploring approaches to protein-misfolding diseases.

name: Practical Sensors
summary: Develop practical ways to detect and measure molecules, adapting analytical sensing methods and devices.

name: Quantum Computing
summary: Explore quantum states, communication, algorithms, and error correction through mathematical models and Python.

name: Robot Learning
summary: Investigate how machine learning can help robots interact with the physical world and develop more general capabilities.

name: Supra Sensors
summary: Use chemical sensing and statistical analysis to investigate the composition of biological samples, including wine and plants.

name: Sustainable Fashion Materials
summary: Experiment with biomaterials and product prototypes to explore alternatives to petroleum-based fashion materials.

name: Urban Ecosystems
summary: Study contaminants, organisms, and ecosystem change in urban waterways, including Waller Creek on the UT campus.

name: Virtual Cures
summary: Combine computational screening of molecules with laboratory protein experiments to investigate potential drug candidates.

name: White Dwarf Stars
summary: Study stars with astronomical data, stellar simulations, and laboratory astrophysics, using programming and data analysis.

name: X-Plants
summary: Investigate perennial-grass biology through mutant plants, genomic analysis, and field or greenhouse observations.
